analysis.title: Market Rhythm Focus
key_insights: KOSPI rose 6.6% in the session, clearing a small base and retaking the gap. Short-term upside can extend, with focus on 6,368, 6,473 and 6,558 where gaps and moving averages cluster.

Philadelphia Semiconductors reacted to the 200dma and an oversold setup, with a three white soldiers candlestick pattern and improving momentum. Short term is much better, but 11,800 and 11,900 remains important resistance within a still-damaged trend.

S&P 500 Equal Weighted ETF (RSP) has recovered and stayed above the 50dma recently. It performed well when AI-related stocks struggled. With AI now inflecting higher, the equal-weighted move could lose momentum and pause.

Russell 2000 and Russell Microcap both bounced yesterday, but only Russell 2000 is back above the 200dma, with Microcap still below. The short-term pattern looks like a developing bear flag rather than a trend change, and downward-sloping 50dmas pointing to death crosses add to the caution.

Stoxx Europe 600 has retaken the 50dma after failing to hold it on the previous two attempts. Price is still below the mid-August downtrend, RSI is subdued and the 50dma is curving lower, so the setup remains cautious.

US high yield spreads widened recently, which was a concern, and this week's tightening is a welcome step. EFG still needs a clear break of the uptrend to properly reduce risk for equities and credit.
